title: Validate the Data Extractor
objective: Never let a broken record into the finance system.
description: This workflow reads a messy forwarded email and pulls out a clean invoice record: who, what, how much, in which currency, due when. The Validator is already strict, and it is already told to send a wrong record back to the extractor for repair, with the problems spelled out. But the model does not always return a record at all - sometimes it replies with JSON that will not parse, and the step blows up before the Validator ever sees it. Protect the extractor itself with a Retry block so the first mangled reply costs you an attempt, not the run.

sample_input.text: hey - passing this on, sorry it's a mess. Vendor is Northwind Logistics (accounts@northwind.test). Their invoice NW-2291 landed today, 4820.50 EUR, payment terms net 30 so due 2026-04-15. Ref our contract from last spring. Thanks! -- J

expected_output: An invoice record with name, email, invoice_number, amount_due (a number), currency (USD, EUR or GBP) and due_date.

config.prompt: Extract a structured invoice record. Return JSON with name, email, invoice_number, amount_due, currency and due_date.
config.system: You extract structured records. Return only valid JSON, never prose.

config.review_prompt: The extracted record does not match the invoice schema.

solution_hint: The Validator can only catch a record it receives. A reply that will not parse never becomes one - it fails the step outright. Splice a Retry block between 'Messy email' and 'Extract the invoice' with max attempts 2: the second reply parses, the Validator checks it, and the record ships.

failure_scenarios.label: The model returns broken JSON
failure_scenarios.description: The extractor's first reply cannot be parsed at all. Its second reply is clean.

detail.message: The extractor replied with JSON that could not be parsed.

failure_scenarios.label: The model forgets the due date
failure_scenarios.description: The extractor's first record has no due_date. Sent back with the problem spelled out, its second answer is complete.

rules.label: drop record.due_date from the first answer

completion_criteria: A Retry block protects the extractor
The extractor recovers from its broken reply
The Validator passes on the repaired record
The clean record carries an invoice number
The run finishes at the Output block
